verdict.rationale: Ramp is a SaaS platform (not itself an agent), and the axis applies; probe evidence confirms an official MCP server documented at support.ramp.com/ramp-mcp, alongside a companion developer API/CLI ecosystem (llms.txt, OpenAPI spec, official CLI). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of connecting an agent to the MCP server or details on its tool coverage/reliability.
